Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations: 

  • Capitol Square (towards Central and Dulwich Hill / The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at Central Grand Concourse or walk to Central Station (approx. 7 minute walk), 
  • Exhibition Centre (towards Dulwich Hill / The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at Convention (approx. 7 minute walk), 
  • Pyrmont Bay (towards Central and Dulwich Hill / The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at The Star (approx. 5 minute walk). 
See the news story for more detailed service information. 
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
content:
Ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water on Sunday 26 January.
 
Ferries will not run to and from Circular Quay from 11:45am to 12:45pm. and will use Barangaroo wharf instead.
 
In the evening ferries will not run during the evening exclusion zone, the last ferry leaves Circular Quay at 5:45pm and Cockatoo Island at 6:19pm. Services resume with additional late-night ferries leaving Circular Quay at 10:05pm and 11:05pm, and from Cockatoo Island at 10:35pm and 11:35pm direct to Circular Quay.
 
For more details on ferry service changes and other transport options, visit the Australia Day event page.
